data.title: 萝丝 · 王权圣殿的誓约与思念
data.description: 加冕后的奥利安娜大教堂空旷回廊中，红地毯一直延伸到尽头高耸的拱窗。头戴白金王冠的萝丝伫立在窗前凝望夜空，暗暗向暗影起誓守护国家。
data.location: vast vaulted royal palace corridor lined with stained glass lancet windows and red carpet
data.action: standing tall beside an arched window holding a royal ceremonial rapier upright, gaze directed toward starry sky above, regal yet longing expression
data.lighting: 殿堂壁炉烛光与拱窗苍凉月华
data.promptProse: Queen Rose in her white and gold coronation gown stands in a palatial stained-glass gallery, looking out into the night sky with a loyal, yearning heart.
data.animaCaption: Lancet window moonlight catches her golden crown as she whispers a silent vow.
